stereotypeDefinition.comment: Overrides how the guardrail contract declares this property (an attribute, or a navigable association end). Required adds the C# required modifier, as the code declares it.
stereotypeDefinition.name: Property Configuration

property.hint: Tick when the code declares this property required (C# 11), e.g. public required string Name { get; init; }. On its first merge into an existing file, Merge replaces a property's modifiers with the generated ones, so an unmodelled required is dropped. Ignored on a positional record's fields, which are constructor parameters.
property.name: Required

property.hint: The property's access modifier as the code declares it. none writes no access modifier (C#'s private). Empty means public. On its first merge into an existing file, Merge replaces a property's modifiers with the generated ones, so an unmodelled access modifier becomes public. Ignored on a positional record's fields, which are constructor parameters.
property.name: Access Modifier
